Korean Bbq Beef
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:11am

Ingredients




2 pounds Beef sirloin tips cut into pieces
1/2 cup Soy sauce
6 tablespoons Sugar
6 Green onions
2 cl Garlic, minced
4 tablespoons Sesame oil
1 tablespoon Sesame seeds

Preparation

1 (The Meades) 2 Mix it all together and marinate at least 2 hours. Can either cook it on the grill as kebabs or stir-fry by itself. Enjoy. 3 When I don't have sirloin tips, I use flank steak and it tastes just as good. Also, I substitute hot pepper sesame oil and also add cayenne pepper for more kick. The sugar allows the beef to caramelize a little (I tried using cane sugar once but it didn't caramelize). 4 NOTES: Just tried this recipe recently (4 or 5 times) and it is absolutely wonderful - from Omaha Steaks recipe book
